head_commit.message:
magga: Frostbite — Classic & Remastered at /magga/frostbite/

The 1983 arctic igloo builder in two versions on one shared simulation:
cartridge-exact Classic (160x192 NTSC 2600 frame, TIA-style sound,
games 1-4) and a Remastered edition with aurora nights, living ice,
animated characters, frost, snow and synthesized audio. Arrow keys on
desktop, multi-touch pads and swipes on iPhone and Android.

Catalogued as the newest live card on THE DLC SHELF; sitemap lists the
three pages. Payload is a byte-for-byte copy of
VeigaPunk/MAKEARMORGAMESGREATAGAIN games/frostbite/ (README and
verification tools aside): no external requests, zero console errors on
every page.
